title: Workspace telemetry request classifier and delivery paths
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a consistent intake + automated classification flow for workspace-level telemetry and reporting requests (usage slices, cost breakdowns, ad-hoc exports, dashboard templates). Currently requests arrive via support, CSM, and ad-hoc Slack/Forms; triage is manual and turnaround varies widely. This ticket defines: 1) a lightweight NLP classifier for free-text request categorization, 2) SLA lanes and delivery paths mapped to enterprise contracts, 3) standard request templates, and 4) automated routing to the Console Insights backlog or a dedicated exports queue. Goal is to reduce manual triage time, improve SLA predictability for enterprise customers, and increase the percent of requests that can be handled by self-serve templates or automated exports.
acceptance_criteria:
- Classifier prototype built that maps incoming request text to one of: {Usage Slice, Cost Breakdown, Raw Event Export, Dashboard Template, Billing Reconciliation}
- >70% precision on a 200-request holdout set for the top-3 categories
- SLA lanes defined (Express: 3 business days for enterprise with SLA; Standard: 10 business days; Self-serve: immediate) and documented in Console playbook
- Request intake form template embedded in support/CS flow + example payloads and required fields for each export type
- Routing implemented: automatic create to ENG/EXPORTS queue or flag for manual review when confidence < 0.6
- Dashboard showing TAT, auto-classification rate, and backlog by lane available in staging dashboard
- Engineering and Security sign-off on PII/retention constraints for automated exports
comments: 2026-02-11 - Aisha: Kickoff with CSM and Support. Collected 340 historical request texts from last 12 months. Initial themes: ad-hoc billing exports, cost allocation by tag, token-level usage by route, scheduled CSV dumps.

2026-02-17 - Liam: Spike complete. Built baseline classifier (logistic regression + TFIDF) and a simple dashboard in Metabase. Early precision 0.62 on top-3 labels. Noted noisy user language around 'cost report' vs 'billing report'.

2026-02-22 - Design (Maya): Created 3 intake form mockups (Minimal, Guided, Enterprise). PM prefers Guided for default. Need to add required contract id and export schema selector for enterprise lanes.
2026-02-26 - Security (Jon): Raised retention/PII questions for Raw Event Export lane. Requires data contract and template for redaction checklist before automated delivery.

2026-03-02 - Eng (Priya): Proposed routing implementation using existing Console webhook -> linear API flow. Will add confidence threshold and manual review flag. PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4123
2026-03-04 - Aisha: Reviewed cost impact. Estimated 25% reduction in manual triage load, and expected 40% of requests resolvable via self-serve templates after rollout.
2026-03-06 - Liam: Ready for design/eng review handoff. Need final signoff on SLA definitions and calendar availability for pilot customers.

notes: Pilot plan: invite 4 enterprise accounts (2 billing-heavy, 2 usage-heavy) for a two-week trial of the intake form and SLA lanes. Measure TAT and customer satisfaction NPS. If classifier confidence <0.6, route to dedicated CS triage with 24h SLA acknowledgement. Roadmap item: expand classifier to suggest template parameters (date range, granularity, tag filters) in Q3.
